title: Interior design studio in Kyiv — from $30/m² | CAS Development
description: Interior design for apartments, houses and commercial spaces: layouts, 3D, working drawings, specifications. From $30/m², online for clients abroad.
h1: Interior design — in Kyiv and online worldwide
lead: CAS Development designs interiors for apartments, private houses and commercial spaces. We design so that the interior can be built within budget — and we build it ourselves if you wish.
about: A design studio that thinks about implementation

A beautiful picture is only half the job. We design with real prices for materials, works and furniture in mind, so the interior from the 3D fits the budget. The drawings are made for builders: where the sockets go, how the lighting runs, which tile and where the joint is.
We work in different styles — modern minimalism, neoclassical, loft, Scandinavian, Japandi — and our portfolio includes penthouses, private houses, villas, restaurants and offices in Kyiv and abroad.
For clients outside Ukraine the whole process can run online: you send plans, measurements and photos or a video walkthrough, and receive a full set of documents your local contractor can follow.
steps: We get to know you and discuss style, habits and budget.
Several furniture layout options to choose from.
Every room shown in 3D, with revisions.
A complete documentation package for the builders.
Optionally — renovation, furniture and author supervision.
faq: How much does interior design cost?
From $30 per m², with a minimum project budget of $2 500.
What does a design project include?
Layouts, 3D visualisations, working drawings (electrics, plumbing, ceilings, floors), material and furniture specifications and an estimate.
It depends on the area and number of revisions; the timeline is fixed in the contract.
Yes, we design properties in other cities and countries online.
Do you implement the project as well?
Yes: renovation from $550 per m², purchasing of materials, furniture and decor. If our team does the renovation, the estimate is kept within ±5%.
